behavior-tests.source: GOB 379 stores a 35-second sweep with a five-second update and 20% NegativeConditionSweepPulse. tempmods.py checks each dispellable debuff parent once.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHostile.ApplySweep installs one periodic record; TimedEffects drives it at the stored interval. AbilityHostile.Pulse preserves exempt debuffs and unrelated buffs.

area.source: GOB 379 has selector 9 and a nine-metre radius.
area.runtime: AbilitySupport.Targets selects the living caster and mission teammates in radius; AbilitySupport.Land applies the sweep to those recipients.
area.test: AbilityHostileTests.GroupSweepLandsOnlyOnLivingTeamMembersWithinStoredRadius verifies both sides of the stored radius and excludes a dead member and nearby outsider.

area.source: GOB 693 has selector 9 and six-metre radius, and 378 applies it via ApplyAuraEffect.
area.runtime: AbilityAuras uses AbilitySupport.Land with the child radius; only the caster and living teammates inside it receive the buff.

behavior-tests.source: The GOB 693 child stores DoNothing with presentation FX and a 4% NegativeConditionSweepPulse term. virii.py DeflectVirus1Effect_DirectObject queues the 0.2-second parent FX.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityAuras invokes AbilitySupport.Land on the child and dispatches Virii.ApplyDeflectEffect on successful application. AbilityBuffs.Remove routes the four-percent termination callback to AbilityHostile.Pulse.
behavior-tests.test: HackerConditionSweepMode verifies parent 378 dispatches the child defenses and 0.2-second FX across the actual recipient set and removes the expiring record. AbilityHealthCallbackTests.DeflectVirusChildCarriesScaledDefencesAndRunsItsFourPercentTermCleanseOnce verifies real debuff removal and single termination.

targeting.source: GOB 1095 stores self selector 1 and stacking type 37.
targeting.runtime: AbilitySupport.Targets resolves self independently of the selected object; AbilityBuffs uses the same class family as the other replacements.
targeting.test: AbilityHostileTests.UpgradeArtistKeepsItsSweepAndStatsUntilClassReplacement verifies self selection and class replacement.

stats.source: GOB 1095 has while-enabled +5 IS cost reduction, +7 Concentration and +20 Combat Evasion.
stats.runtime: The catalog buff exposes the stats to AbilityCosts, AbilityCastInterrupts and the existing CombatInsightEngagement evasion score.
stats.test: AbilityHostileTests.UpgradeArtistKeepsItsSweepAndStatsUntilClassReplacement checks the values and their consumers.

script.source: GOB 1095 stores NegativeConditionSweepPulse with 10%, five-second interval and duration type 2.
script.runtime: AbilityBuffs schedules a pulse on activation in AbilityHostile.ApplySweep and cancels it on class replacement.
script.test: AbilityHostileTests.UpgradeArtistKeepsItsSweepAndStatsUntilClassReplacement drives the first miss and next successful threshold roll plus removal.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 1095 is a self class upgrade with three fixed stats and a 10% cleanse pulse every five seconds until replaced.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilitySupport, AbilityBuffs and TimedEffects apply and remove the class modifiers together.
behavior-tests.test: AbilityHostileTests.UpgradeArtistKeepsItsSweepAndStatsUntilClassReplacement verifies self selection, stats, periodic outcomes and cleanup.
